name: Vivid MCP
description: Vivid MCP lets you open a Vivid Business account directly from your AI chat. Share your company details or upload registration documents, and the server extracts the information and builds an onboarding link to create your account with details pre-filled-no tab switching required. Then verify your identity and start banking. Works with any MCP-compatible client and requires no API key.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vivid MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vivid MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.prime.vivid.money/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Vivid MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Vivid MCP scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vivid MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vivid MCP provides these MCP tools: build_onboarding_link.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vivid MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Vivid MCP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Vivid MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vivid MCP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Vivid MCP is developed by Vivid Money. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
